name: Jack De Santo
source:
Jack De Santo (first name is customizable) is the main character of Origin Story. He is a slim, fit, tanned young man with a ruffled spiky shock of short brown hair. In a world where most people gain virus-induced super powers during puberty, Jack is a 19 year old "normie", a person who has failed to manifest a super power. As a normie, he is something of an outcast and is shunned and often mistreated by most of his peers, though he maintains a tight cluster of close friends who all look out for each other.

He is also a virgin, as is his best friend Evelyn. A year before the story begins, around their 18th birthdays, the two of them made a pact to exchange their v-cards together the following year if they had not lost their virginities by their 19th birthdays.

As the story begins, Jack's birthday has just passed and Evelyn's birthday is just days away; neither of them has lost their virginity. While they both play it cool, each of them is looking forward to completing their pact together more than they let on to the other. Unfortunately explosive events interrupt their plans, and it is your job to help Jack through the events and decisions that follow.
